name: chattysalamander
style: A big pink axolotl salamander creature from a whimsical hand-drawn cartoon survival game: powerful but cute, a warm throaty amphibian voice with chirps and croaks, no words, no music.

step.prompt: A single soft damp padded footstep of a heavy amphibian creature on earth.

talk.prompt: A friendly axolotl creature talks in its own language, warm throaty chirps, croaky trills and soft warbles.

happy.prompt: A big cute axolotl creature makes a happy rolling chirp and a bright croaky trill.

sad.prompt: A big cute amphibian creature whines sadly, a soft low mournful croon.

surprised.prompt: A startled amphibian creature lets out a sharp surprised chirp and a gulp.

angry.prompt: A big amphibian creature hisses and growls, a wet throaty warning hiss, fierce but not monstrous.

eat.prompt: A big creature chomps food and swallows it, a wet crunchy munch and a gulp.

attack.prompt: A quick fierce snapping bite with a short throaty growl, jaws snapping shut.

hurt.prompt: A big cute amphibian creature yelps in pain, a short croaky squeal.

die.prompt: A big amphibian creature lets out a long fading mournful croak and slumps to the ground with a soft thud.

sleep.prompt: A big creature sleeps, slow soft wet snoring breaths with a gentle croak.

wake.prompt: A big creature wakes up with a long croaky yawn and a soft grumble.
